fullTextZH: 同时，我也是一名在墨西哥的中文导游。
fullTextEN: At the same time, I am also a Chinese tour guide in Mexico.

fullTextZH: 墨西哥有一种交通方式叫 Colectivo。
fullTextEN: In Mexico, there is a type of transportation called Colectivo.

fullTextZH: 你知道 Colectivo 是什么吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what a Colectivo is?

fullTextZH: 它可以是一辆坐 5 个人的小车，
fullTextEN: It can be a small car that seats 5 people,

fullTextZH: 可以是一辆坐 16 个人的面包车，
fullTextEN: It can be a van that seats 16 people,

fullTextZH: 也可以是一辆坐很多很多很多人的公交车。
fullTextEN: It can also be a bus that seats many, many, many people.

fullTextZH: 最近，我去瓦哈卡看朋友。
fullTextEN: Recently, I went to Oaxaca to see friends.

fullTextZH: 我坐的是一辆可以坐 5 个人的小车。
fullTextEN: I took a small car that can seat 5 people.

fullTextZH: 坐一次 Colectivo 是 15 比索，
fullTextEN: A ride on a Colectivo is 15 pesos,
Before I got on the car,
There are already three people in the car,
There is also a driver in the car,
No more new people can come.
Because the car is driving very fast,
so I want to fasten the seatbelt.

fullTextZH: 你们猜猜司机说了什么？
fullTextEN: Can you guess what the driver said?

fullTextZH: 司机说：“我们没有安全带，
fullTextEN: The driver said, "We don't have seatbelts,

fullTextZH: 这个时候，我觉得很害怕，
fullTextEN: At this moment, I felt very scared,
because I felt it was very dangerous.
The car was driving very fast,

fullTextZH: 而且我发现，看到红灯的时候，
fullTextEN: Moreover, I noticed that when seeing a red light,
and said someone would get on.
no more new people could get on.
and told me to sit in the middle.

fullTextZH: 这个女生坐在我的旁边，
fullTextEN: This girl sat next to me,
and I sat in the middle.
I was taking a Colectivo in Mexico,
The car was driving very fast,
I felt it was very dangerous.
Am I very angry or very happy?

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得我又在穷游了。
fullTextEN: because I feel like I'm backpacking again.

fullTextZH: 你们知道什么是穷游吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what backpacking is?

fullTextZH: 所以，穷游就是没有很多钱的旅游。
fullTextEN: So, backpacking means traveling without much money.
This is the feeling of Mexico,
This is the feeling of backpacking.
